property_summary: After any fallback call with msg.value == 10 ether, if the block number is divisible by 15 the contract balance becomes 0 (reference); the mutant with divisor 14 may leave a non-zero balance when the block number is divisible by 14 but not 15.
change_summary: Change the divisor in the block number check from 15 to a different number (e.g., 14).
